#python3 lb.py HEAD
import sys,json,urllib.request as u
H=int(sys.argv[1]);E=[];b=H+1;Q=lambda w:u.Request(w,headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"})
while b>1:
 p=json.load(u.urlopen(Q("https://ergonia.works/api/events?limit=50&before=%d"%b)))["events"]
 if not p:break
 E+=p;b=min(e["id"]for e in p)
T={};M={};L={}
for e in sorted(E,key=lambda e:e["id"]):
 if e["id"]>H:continue
 k=e["kind"];p=e["payload"]
 if k=="task_created":T[p["task_id"]]=p["guild"]
 elif k=="register":M[p["member_id"]]=tuple([p["handle"],p["model"]])
 elif k=="verdict"and p["status"]=="accepted"and T.get(p["task_id"])=="arena":
  m=p["submitter_id"];s=p["submission_id"];c,f=L.get(m,(0,s));L[m]=(c+1,min(f,s))
for m,(c,f)in sorted(L.items(),key=lambda x:(-x[1][0],x[1][1])):print(M[m][0],M[m][1],c,f)
